user.title: Hearth
user.description: Adds the Hearth panel to the sidebar. Rooms are built from Home Assistant areas; outdoor sensors and the rest are set later in the options.

init.title: Hearth panel settings
init.description: Empty fields and lists = the panel finds things itself (rooms from areas, persons, gates, waste, consumers and gas from the Energy dashboard). Enter exceptions only.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.description: Tabs, room card style and the sidebar entry. Each device can pick its own card style in the panel (gear icon).

data_description.tabs: Which tabs to show and in what order: selection order = panel order (remove and add again to move one). The first opens by default.
data_description.require_admin: Hides the panel from regular users.
data_description.accent_color: Colour of buttons, selections, tabs and the Agent page; state colours (heating, alarms) stay. A custom #rrggbb can be typed. Each device can pick its own in the panel settings.

outdoor.name: Outdoor
outdoor.description: Sensors outside (Climate tab). Empty field = tile without that value.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Also used to compare with indoor humidity.
data_description.outdoor_aqi_level: E.g. very_low / low / medium / high / very_high.

house.name: House bar
house.description: House status bar above the rooms in the Climate tab (the boiler comes from the Boiler section).

data_description.presence: On/off entity, e.g. a household group.
data_description.tariff: Shown next to ventilation, dehumidifiers and in the Energy tab.

home.name: Home tab
home.description: Persons (click = map), gates, mailbox, waste and weather (forecast, radar, Windy).

data_description.persons: Empty = every person with a phone. Battery and steps from the person's phone.
data_description.gates: Empty = covers of class gate, garage and door.
data_description.waste_calendar: Empty = the Waste Collection Schedule calendar. A category shows only when it has a date.
data_description.waste: Instead of the calendar: sensors with the pickup date (e.g. waste_collection_schedule sensors).
data_description.waste_toggles: input_boolean enabling a category (e.g. waste_bio_active). Off hides it; the switch is in the panel settings. Empty = helpers with “waste” in the name.
data_description.weather: Empty = Open-Meteo (ECMWF) forecast for the home location.

energy.name: Energy tab
energy.description: Consumption and costs come from the HA Energy dashboard; here only live measurements.

data_description.power_total: Power sensor in W or kW (e.g. from a meter/analyser).
data_description.consumers: Empty = devices from the Energy dashboard (power from the same device).
data_description.consumers_exclude: Power or energy sensors of devices to hide (e.g. powered from a UPS that is measured itself).

boiler.name: Boiler
boiler.description: House bar and the Boiler tab. With ebusd: flame + hot water demand instead of a state entity.

data_description.boiler_state: Ready state, e.g. HEATING / STANDBY. With ebusd leave empty and pick the flame.
data_description.gas: Empty = gas from the Energy dashboard. Daily and monthly charts from statistics.
data_description.boiler_settings: number / input_number entities with −/+ in the Boiler tab.
data_description.ebusd_zone_topic: E.g. ebusd/ctlv2/Z1. In Auto mode heating −/+ starts Quick Veto (MQTT …SFMode, …QuickVetoTemp); changing the mode ends it. Empty = plain setpoint change.
data_description.boiler_sf_mode: Special function sensor (e.g. auto / veto) — “Veto until …” status.

meters.name: Meters tab
meters.description: Any entities — the panel groups them by device (e.g. meter, supplier, softener, dishwasher).

data_description.meters: Empty = water and gas from the Energy dashboard.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Extra rules for rooms built from areas (Climate tab).

data_description.areas: Areas shown as rooms, in this order. Empty = every area with a thermostat.
data_description.helper_prefix: E.g. “heating” for input_number.heating_AREA_komfort/_eko/_wieczor and alike. Empty = control the thermostat only.
data_description.fans: Switches and fans shown as the room fan (fan.* and names with “fan” are found automatically).
data_description.exclude_entities: E.g. a dishwasher door sensor detected as a room door.

switches.name: Switches tab
switches.description: Lights, plugs and fans from HA areas, grouped by room.

data_description.switch_exclude: E.g. technical relays that shouldn't be at hand.

data_description.cameras: Empty = Frigate cameras (or all when there is no Frigate). Drag to reorder.

vehicles.name: Cars and Robots tabs
vehicles.description: Cars from trackers (data from the device: fuel, range, odometer, battery, lock); mowers and vacuums are found automatically.

data_description.vehicles: Empty = trackers whose device has an odometer or range.

appliances.name: Appliances
appliances.description: The Appliances tab finds fridges and other Home Connect appliances, hOn dishwashers and EcoWater softeners by itself.

data_description.appliances_exclude: Devices not to show in the Appliances tab.

proxmox.name: Proxmox tab
proxmox.description: Nodes, VMs, containers and storage from the built-in Proxmox VE integration.

data_description.proxmox_disks: List: - guest: vm-name, label: boot (optional), used: sensor.used, total: sensor.size. Without an entry the panel looks for sensor.GUEST_disk_used / _disk_size.

data_description.net_status: Connectivity binary_sensors (e.g. ping to router, Google).
data_description.net_ports: Port status and PoE switches — grouped by device.

extras.name: Alerts and Agent
extras.description: Alert rules (badge on the tab) and the Agent tab page.

data_description.alerts: List: - entity: sensor.x, condition: "< 20" (or "== open", "!= on"), message: text, severity: error / warn / info.
data_description.agent_url: Page shown in the Agent tab (e.g. a path under HA).

user.title: New person in the Health tab
user.description: Only name, sex and a weight sensor are required. Each further section enables its own page: Body composition, Activity, Blood pressure, Measurements, Growth charts and Data entry (body circumferences).

data_description.name: Label in the panel.
data_description.person: Optional — picture from the person profile.
data_description.birthdate: Age in the blood-pressure report and growth charts.
data_description.height: Sensor or input_number with height (cm, or m from a phone) — for BMI.
data_description.height_cm: When there is no height entity.
data_description.start_weight: Baseline for loss and goal progress; empty = first value in history.
data_description.start_date: Empty = day of the first value in history.
data_description.history_days: How many days of weight statistics to load.

body.name: Body composition
body.description: Sensors from a body-composition scale. Without them the Body composition page is hidden.

activity.name: Activity
activity.description: Daily step and calorie counters (reset at midnight).

pressure.name: Blood pressure
pressure.description: Without a systolic sensor the Blood pressure page is hidden.

data_description.bp_category: Optional text sensor; without it the category is computed from the values.

measurements.name: Body measurements
measurements.description: Circumferences in cm (sensors with statistics or input_number).

entry.name: Data entry
entry.description: Page for manual input of body circumferences. Weight, body composition, blood pressure, height and activity come from phones and the scale.

data_description.goals: Progress, forecast and lines on the weight chart.
data_description.centiles: BMI and height against WHO 2007 references; needs the date of birth.

date.name: Deadline
